title: Playboy Magazine December 1976 Pennington Borkman Gala Christmas Issue
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, December 1976 Gala Christmas Issue, featuring Ann Pennington (Miss March 1976) and Deborah Borkman (Miss July 1976) on the cover.
Inside: "How's This for Starters?" — original fiction from Norman Mailer, Dick Gregory, Joyce Carol Oates, Mario Puzo, Bruce Jay Friedman and Robert Sheckley; Honey Bruce on life with Lenny Bruce; an interview with O.J. Simpson; "Sex Stars of 1976"; the Playboy Music Poll; and a feature on Fellini's new film on Casanova.
Complete issue, no missing pages noted. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
